disclaimer: Treatment rules provide preliminary visual screening suggestions only and are not medical diagnoses.

none.title: Alignment Within Typical Limits
none.action: Routine monitoring during regular dental visits
home_care: Continue regular daily brushing and flossing
Monitor for any shifting or spacing changes over time

mild.title: Minor Alignment Variation
mild.action: Consider elective orthodontic consultation if alignment improvement is desired
home_care: Use interdental brushes or floss threaders around crowded areas
Ensure extra attention when brushing tight contact points

moderate.title: Orthodontic Evaluation for Crowding / Spacing
moderate.action: Orthodontic evaluation to assess bite alignment, crowding, or spacing
home_care: Clean thoroughly along crowded surfaces where plaque tends to accumulate
Use waxed dental floss or water flosser for tight contact areas

marked.title: Noticeable Alignment Irregularity
marked.action: Comprehensive orthodontic evaluation for functional bite and arch alignment
home_care: Maintain diligent hygiene around rotated or crowded teeth
Avoid biting hard non-food objects that can stress misaligned teeth

uncertain.title: Alignment Observation Inconclusive
uncertain.action: In-person dental examination for direct clinical visual check
home_care: Standard daily oral hygiene routine

none.title: Surface Coloration Within Typical Range
none.action: Maintain daily oral hygiene and biannual preventive cleanings
home_care: Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste for two minutes
Limit consumption of staining foods and beverages

mild.title: Possible Surface Staining
mild.action: Professional dental examination and prophylaxis cleaning assessment
home_care: Rinse mouth with water after coffee, tea, or dark sauces
Use a soft-bristled toothbrush with gentle circular motions

moderate.title: Visible Extrinsic Staining or Uneven Coloration
moderate.action: Professional hygiene cleaning and enamel surface assessment
home_care: Avoid highly abrasive charcoal or baking soda pastes that can erode enamel
Maintain twice-daily brushing with enamel-safe fluoride toothpaste

marked.title: Prominent Discoloration / Staining
marked.action: Comprehensive clinical evaluation to differentiate extrinsic stain from subsurface changes
home_care: Brush gently with fluoride toothpaste
Schedule a professional cleaning to safely remove accumulated deposits

uncertain.title: Discoloration Observation Inconclusive
uncertain.action: In-person visual check under standard operatory lighting
home_care: Standard daily oral hygiene routine

none.title: Tooth Surfaces Show No Notable Flattening
home_care: Use a soft-bristle toothbrush to protect natural enamel
Maintain balanced diet and stay hydrated

mild.title: Possible Minor Incisal / Occlusal Wear
mild.action: Dental evaluation to monitor edge wear and discuss nocturnal clenching or dietary acids
home_care: Avoid chewing hard ice, pens, or fingernails
Wait 30 minutes before brushing after consuming acidic foods or citrus

moderate.title: Visible Tooth Flattening or Edge Chipping
moderate.action: Occlusal wear assessment; discuss night guard / bite splint evaluation
home_care: Practice daytime jaw relaxation (lips together, teeth apart)
Use desensitizing fluoride toothpaste if temperature sensitivity occurs

marked.title: Marked Tooth Wear or Noticeable Chipping
marked.action: Comprehensive occlusal evaluation with general dentist or prosthodontist
home_care: Protect compromised tooth edges by avoiding crunchy or hard items
Consult dentist promptly for protective occlusal appliance evaluation

uncertain.title: Tooth Wear Observation Inconclusive
home_care: Standard gentle brushing with soft bristles

none.title: Gum Margin Appears Healthy & Pink
none.action: Continue regular maintenance and biannual preventive cleanings
home_care: Floss gently once daily along the gum line
Brush with gentle 45-degree angle towards the gingival margin

mild.title: Possible Mild Gingival Redness Along Margin
mild.action: Dental hygiene evaluation and plaque-control coaching
home_care: Floss daily to remove interdental plaque
Use an alcohol-free antiseptic or saltwater mouth rinse for 7 days

moderate.title: Visible Redness or Marginal Swelling
moderate.action: Gingival health examination and professional periodontal assessment
home_care: Brush gently with an ultra-soft toothbrush along the gumline
Do not stop brushing or flossing if gums bleed; gentle cleaning is essential

marked.title: Marked Gingival Redness or Evident Tissue Inflammation
marked.action: Specialist periodontal consultation and thorough periodontal pocket charting
home_care: Use gentle chlorhexidine or antimicrobial mouth rinse as advised by clinician
Avoid smoking or tobacco products which aggravate periodontal tissues
Seek professional periodontal care promptly

uncertain.title: Gum Appearance Observation Inconclusive
uncertain.action: In-person gingival examination with periodontal probing
home_care: Gentle daily flossing and soft brushing

general_preventive.title: Comprehensive Preventive Oral Examination
general_preventive.action: Biannual dental examination, professional cleaning, and diagnostic check
home_care: Brush twice daily for two minutes with fluoride toothpaste
Floss once daily between all teeth
Limit sugary and acidic snacks between meals
